# sheppakai-apps Copilot Instructions

pnpm monorepo with three SvelteKit (Svelte 5 runes) apps and shared workspace packages.

## Layout

- `apps/budget`: household budget and side-business bookkeeping
- `apps/mealplanner`: pantry-driven dinner planning
- `apps/synapse`: personal life management (tasks, journal, fitness)
- `packages/logger`: shared structured logger (`@sheppakai/logger`)
- `packages/shared`: server/client modules shared by all three apps (`@sheppakai/shared/<module>`)

## Where the guidance lives

There is one source of agent guidance, and it is not under `.github/`:

- `CLAUDE.md` (repo root): repo-wide conventions.
- `apps/<app>/CLAUDE.md`: app-specific stack, conventions and patterns.
- `.claude/skills/` and `.claude/agents/`: shared skills and reviewer agents.

## Conventions

- Use `pnpm`, never `npm`. Shared dependency versions come from the `catalog:` in
  `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.
- Run commands per app with `pnpm --filter <package-name> <script>`, or across the workspace from
  the root: `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm fmt:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.
- Format with oxfmt and lint with oxlint. Do not hand-edit `src/lib/components/ui/` (generated by
  the shadcn-svelte CLI) or `src/lib/server/db/migrations/` (generated by drizzle-kit).
